notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's whole job here is: detect the player walking into an AreaTrigger.dbc volume (exit-latch, first containing row wins, latch cleared on map change) and send CMSG_AREATRIGGER so the SERVER decides what it means. MSUI parses AreaTrigger.dbc, implements the same exit-latch containment check (portal fires once per entry, latch re-seeds on spawn so a return portal does not re-fire), but resolves the destination LOCALLY via a bundled areatrigger_teleport table and teleports itself - it never tells the server.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The local portal path is a deliberate offline/travel affordance (Program.Instances.cs documents H3/P2: 'when P2 lands the server sends a real position and this becomes a debug affordance'). The latch semantics themselves match the reference law.
